note: City of Washburn campground on an open lawn sloping to Lake Superior's Chequamegon Bay at the west end of town. The lakeside premium sites are the row nearest the bank, about 50 m from the water over open grass; the rest sit back among scattered trees. Swimming beach, boat launch and an artesian well. 17 of the 50 sites are seasonal. --Claude
